title: Budget Narrative Attachment Form
description: Budget narrative files supplied as an ordered list of uploaded attachment references.
notes: The first attachment is mandatory; additional attachments follow it in the same list, as in the existing SGG form.
Examples use synthetic attachment IDs. File ownership and metadata are resolved by the existing application service.
Not installed in the API yet. That and the file upload flow are tracked in the migration issue.
No applicant answers are pre- or post-populated. The upload service assigns attachment references when files are uploaded.
Open follow-up on the existing SGG form: #11171 (print E2E).

children.label: Budget Narrative Files
